'''Herren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Herren participated in the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], the exploration of the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. He was a member of the crew of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Daring (transport)|''Daring'']], alongside [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dindau]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] first mate [[Kohlbacca]]. Aboard the ''Daring'', Herren served as its [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. When the ship collided with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], the ''Daring''{{'s}} engines went dead and Herren was hit by the ionic backwash from them. This gave him severe electrical burns and cerebral shock that brought him close to [[Death/Legends|death]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] attempt to rescue Herren and his ship mates before the life support systems on the ''Daring'' failed.
